svg.title: Harbor pilot — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as harbor pilot, wearing a rescue jacket and a service cap. Visible work cue: A three-rung pilot boarding ladder with hooked tops stands beside the stepped upper edge and curved lower hull of a ship. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
